motion.principle: Prefer immediate state changes; use motion only to clarify panel transitions or feedback.

rules: Green, amber, and red communicate state or action; do not use them as decoration.
Use background and inset changes to establish hierarchy; reserve shadows for justified interaction or overlay states.
Preserve the compact, explicit, keyboard-operable utility character during the Vite/React migration.
do: Use monospace typography and explicit labels for operational controls.
Use borders and tonal layers to make panels easy to scan.
Preserve physical-machine vocabulary and meaningful status signals.
dont: Do not use bright gradients, oversized hero sections, or decorative glass effects.
Do not use excessive rounded corners, heavy shadows, or ornamental decoration.
Do not sacrifice accessible contrast, target size, or keyboard operation for nostalgia.
